rtoml.wheel_note: Matching-platform reference wheel only; it is not installed. The official wheel is built with the sdist's release profile (fat LTO, one codegen unit) and no coverage instrumentation.
rtoml.license_evidence: PKG-INFO 'License: MIT' (checked in the Dockerfile) and Cargo.toml license = "MIT"
rtoml.documented_api: README.md 'load' and 'loads' sections: load(toml: str | Path | TextIO, *, none_value=None) and loads(toml: str, *, none_value=None) -> Dict[str, Any]

toml_parser.role: TOML lexer and event parser (the parser under test), resolved by the sdist Cargo.lock; the same release as the selected Rust toml and toml_edit paths

toml.role: Deserializer::parse and the DeTable/DeValue assembly from toml_parser events

toml_datetime.role: date-time value parsing for the four TOML date-time kinds

pyo3.role: Python binding layer, resolved by the sdist Cargo.lock; outside parser coverage scope

build_backend.role: build backend only (rtoml pyproject requires maturin>=1,<2)
